reviews.x: Super easy to use! 5 min to do my daughter's hair this morning and that includes brushing it out and getting a ponytail. The pins this comes with were much better than regular bobby pins. I used the 'donut' in these pictures and added a ribbon.

reviews.t: This is awesome once you get the hang of it I use ...
reviews.x: This is awesome once you get the hang of it I use it on my daughter for her ballet classes and it really holds up and looks very cute.

reviews.t: We have found that wet hair is desirable for the best outcome. The bun will not be full and ...
reviews.x: The donuts worked as intended for our daughter's ballet/dance needs. The "slap bracelet" is a low-impact hold and is not firm to the head. It requires the use of several bobby pins etc to hold tight. We have found that wet hair is desirable for the best outcome.The bun will not be full and round like with the donut, however. It will be based on the fullness/thickness of hair and maybe undesirable for those with very full/thick hair.

I am very challenged in the hair department. Very pleased with these! I have thick hair and both the snap wand and round sponge worked great! My hair was almost too think for the snap band, but it still did the job. My daughter has thin hair and the snap band worked PERFECT! It looks like I know how to style hair now, lol. I love that it makes my daughter's thin hair look so bug and full in the bun. I was shocked. I was able to create the perfect buns with these on the first try. Great price too

I'm currently building a tiny house & during the demo of a camper trailer I used this product to keep my long hair out of my face. I 1st put a high pony in and then used the "slap bracelet" to form a bun around the pony holder. I didn't use any bobby pins or product and this bun held tight for hours of hard manual labor. Love it

reviews.t: Easy to use and create a cute bun
reviews.x: I love how easy these are to use (once I got the initial hang of it). My hair is layered so the front pieces don't stay up but the rest of my hair stays in place and it feels very secure. I don't have to worry about my hair coming undone. I'm very happy with this purchase.

I have a lot of hair and it's long and thick - and I just whipped this up in 5 seconds lol WOW!!  I'm amazed I honestly am ... My hair is so heavy it never stays up on a bun nor looks this nice !!!!  This is exactly what I was hoping for  Something quick to throw my hair up in a hurry  no fuss.  And it looks good  Thank u !!!  I haven't tried the one that looks like a slap bracelet yet just the donut but I m so happy with it I had to share

I bought these for my daughters dance recital and they didn’t work at all for her hair type. Her hair is below her shoulders and thin. Both with the strips and bun shaper her hair would just fall out. I was hopeful and took to the dance teacher thinking she has more experience and would be able to make it work. She had no luck too. We ended up braiding her hair and buying the bun hair net.

This was a good product. Some of the donuts are a little big but it depends on what you like. The snapping hair clip has a learning curve and doesn't come with instructions. The pins are not bobby bins FYI they are for up-dos.
I bought this for my granddaughter's long hair. My daughter did her hair in a jiffy and it stayed all day. My granddaughter danced around the house singing that she looked like a princess.
This is a great way to try different bun products. I was able to easily get hair done in a pinch and find out which one works best with my hair.
Got this for my eleven-year-old daughter. It must be simple to use, as she does it herself. She has medium length, thick hair.

reviews.t: Slap band bun maker sucks don’t waste your money on it tbh
reviews.x: The slap band things suck but the donut buns are good.Wouldve Just spent less money on a package of only donut buns instead :/

As a whole, it does do what it advertises to do. That being said, I find that the materials themselves are little on the cheap side. I have three various size foam inserts for French rolls that I've been using for over twenty years. The quality of those roles versus these is very drastic. They have placed a mesh netting over the bun itself (this may be needed since it's in a bun shape). The foam roller is very porous and rough. The netting I find to be very abrasive. reviews.t: Fine & Thin Hair? These might not work for you!
reviews.x: My wife bought these hoping to use them with her hair. Even the smallest one really didn't work for her hair. She has pretty fine and thin hair (When you pull her hair into a pony tail the pony tail base is no larger than a nickel) and she really didn't have enough hair for this to work for her. The length of your hair has no effect, so it's all about quantity/thickness.

reviews.t: Super easy on thick or thin hair
reviews.x: I have a seven year old with outrageously thick hair and a two year old with thin toddler hair. I used the large and small foam donut things. This worked on both of them and was easy enough on my first use to get my toddler’s hair in it. Note. Every picture of my toddler is slightly blurry unless she’s sleeping. Always on the move. Love it!

I have long gray hair ordered the blond set to blend, color is more yellow than anything. My hair is very thick, the bun maker clip will not hold it. Might work for thinner hair. There are only small pictures on the woven bun maker. Delivery took 10 days and this is a no return item.

reviews.t: I really like the donuts and was very pleasantly surprised at how ...
reviews.x: I really like the donuts and was very pleasantly surprised at how quickly and easily it works to get a great looking bun. I do not like the flat golden pieces. They were very difficult to use and my hair is very fine blonde so it slips out easily - better for coarse hair.

Finally able to put my daughter’s super thick, long hair into a secure bun for dance recital with the donut’s help.  Bun stayed in place for while night and next day.  The straight bun makers are best for thinner hair with few layers.  Not great for thick layers at all.

I have bought the bun pieces separate and spent much more than this price! I am stoked to have sizing options now. We used these on our Disney vacation and it was a great way to keep the kids hair up and off their neck without a lot of prep work. Very sassy to use

The long bun maker pieces are not user friendly or at least they weren’t for me. Very hard to bend and hair is not easy to manipulate around to cover. Could just be me but feel like it should be easier to use.

reviews.t: Easy to use; so many compliments
reviews.x: Got the blonde and it had the blonde and brown hair ties. Worked great in my fine, wavy, not quite shoulder length hair. I normally wear my hair up...cuz kids....and I received so many compliments using this.
All of these products fell apart or broke with in just a few uses. The straight product turned strange colors and would not work after only the second use. It’s a great theory but needs work.
I really love this!! I am working on growing out my hair and like that I will have options as it grows. The bobby pins are a god send but I havent had luck with the wrap bun makers.

reviews.t: Broken before we could use... the rest was junk
reviews.x: One of two hair wraps were broken upon arrival. Very cheaply made, bun makers also created and falling apart. The ponies provided were of t-shirt material, no elasticity.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bun makers easy and quick to use, often getting a finished bun in minutes or even seconds.
Several reviewers report the bun holds securely and stays in place for hours, including for dance and active use.
Multiple reviewers say the product does not work well for fine or thin hair, with hair falling out or not having enough volume.
Some reviewers note a learning curve, especially with the snap/slap band, and mention it lacks instructions or needs extra pins for a firm hold.
A few reviewers criticize the slap band specifically or find the materials cheap, preferring the donut buns.
